description_en: Changes the resource group of an IPAM resource
description_zh: 修改IPAM资源所属的资源组
kebab_example: aliyun vpcipam change-resource-group --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-id ipam-uq5dcfc2eqhpf40000 --new-resource-group-id rg-aek3ctkufaw0000 --resource-type Ipam --region cn-hangzhou
name: ChangeResourceGroup

parameters.help_en: The ID of the hosted region. Call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html to get the region ID
parameters.help_zh: IPAM托管地域ID。您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource whose resource group you want to change
parameters.help_zh: 需要修改资源组的实例ID
parameters.name: resource_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the new resource group
parameters.name: new_resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The resource type. Valid values:

Ipam: an IPAM instance

IpamScope: an IPAM scope

IpamPool: an IPAM pool

IpamResourceDiscovery: an IPAM resource discovery
parameters.help_zh:
资源类型，取值：

Ipam：IPAM实例

parameters.name: resource_type
